tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.rich: Titles in the library catalogue that match a title, an author or a subject, with author, year and ISBN. Not for the copies on a shelf and not for the full details of a title whose ISBN is already known.

params.name: query
params.rich: A title, an author's name or a subject.

params.name: format
params.rich: Limit the results to one format: book, ebook, audiobook or dvd. All formats when omitted.

tools.name: get_book_details
tools.rich: Publisher, year, edition, page count, language and a short summary for one title, by ISBN. Not for finding titles by a phrase and not for the copies on a shelf.

params.name: isbn
params.rich: The ISBN of the edition.

tools.name: check_book_availability
tools.rich: How many copies of one title are on the shelf and how many are out on loan at one branch today. Not for the details of the book and not for reserving a copy.

params.name: isbn
params.rich: The ISBN of the edition.

params.name: branch
params.rich: The branch to check, written by its name.

tools.name: place_hold
tools.terse: Put a hold on a title.
tools.rich: Reserve the next free copy of one title for the patron and name the branch where it will wait for collection. Not for borrowing a digital copy.

params.name: isbn
params.rich: The ISBN of the edition.

params.name: pickup_branch
params.rich: The branch where the copy will wait, written by its name.

tools.name: cancel_hold
tools.rich: Withdraw the patron's hold on one title so that they leave the waiting queue. Not for a loan that is already out.

params.name: isbn
params.rich: The ISBN of the edition.

tools.name: list_my_holds
tools.rich: The titles the patron is waiting for, with queue position and the branch for collection. Not for items that are already borrowed.

params.name: status
params.rich: waiting (still in the queue), ready (waiting at a branch for collection) or all.

tools.name: list_my_loans
tools.rich: The items the patron has out right now, with title, ISBN and due date; an item that is late is marked. Not for holds and not for fines.

params.name: kind
params.rich: print (paper items), ebook (digital loans) or all.

tools.name: renew_loan
tools.rich: Give one borrowed item a new, later due date, if no other patron is waiting for it. Not for a digital loan and not for borrowing a title again once it is back on the shelf.

params.name: isbn
params.rich: The ISBN of the item on loan.

tools.name: check_fines
tools.rich: The late fees the patron owes, each with its item, the days it was late and the amount. Not for the items that are out and not yet late.

params.name: status
params.rich: unpaid (still owed) or all (including fines already paid).

tools.name: get_branch_hours
tools.rich: When one branch opens and closes on one day of the week, or that it is closed that day. Not for the branch's address and not for a closure on a particular date.

params.name: branch
params.rich: The branch, written by its name.

params.name: day
params.rich: The day of the week, spelled out in English.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.rich: The library branches in one district, with street address and phone number. Not for opening hours.

params.name: area
params.rich: A district or neighbourhood, such as the town centre or the harbour.

tools.name: book_reading_room
tools.rich: Reserve a quiet reading room at one branch for a whole number of hours on one date. Not for borrowing items.

params.name: branch
params.rich: The branch, written by its name.

params.name: date
params.rich: The date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: start_time
params.rich: The start time on the 24-hour clock, HH:MM.

params.name: hours
params.rich: Whole hours, 1 to 3; part of an hour counts as a full hour.

tools.name: borrow_ebook
tools.rich: Lend one digital title to the patron's account for the standard loan period, in the file format chosen. Not for a paper copy and not for a title that has to be collected at a branch.

params.name: isbn
params.rich: The ISBN of the title to borrow.

params.name: format
params.rich: epub or pdf.

tools.name: suggest_purchase
tools.rich: Ask the library to add a title it does not hold to its collection. Not for a title that is already in the catalogue.

params.name: title
params.rich: The title of the book.

params.name: author
params.rich: The author's name.

params.name: isbn
params.rich: The ISBN, if known.
